```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
# Path to your GSE folder
folder <- "../../GSE117295_RAW/"

# List all CSV files in the folder
files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "_CT[0-9]+.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Create a list to store Seurat objects for each timepoint
seurat_list <- list()

for (f in files) {
  # Use filename (without extension) as timepoint ID
  timepoint <- stringr::str_extract(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), pattern = "(?<=CT).*")
  
  # Read in the CSV
  dat <- read.csv(f, row.names = 1) 
  
  # Create Seurat object
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = dat, project = timepoint)
  
  # Add metadata for timepoint
  seu$timepoint <- as.numeric(timepoint)
  
  # Store in list
  seurat_list[[timepoint]] <- seu
}

# Merge all Seurat objects into one
combined <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1])

# Check metadata
head(combined@meta.data)

```

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)


obj = combined

# ---- Tunables (adjust to taste) ----
mito_max      <- 5
min_genes     <- 200
train_min     <- 800
n_hvgs        <- 2000
n_pcs         <- 30
cluster_res   <- 0.6
tsne_perp     <- 30
rf_trees      <- 1000
seed          <- 1234

set.seed(seed)

#percent mito
obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^mt-")

# ---- Split into training vs projection by nFeature_RNA ----
training <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA >= train_min)
projection <- subset(obj, subset = nFeature_RNA < train_min & nFeature_RNA > min_genes)

# ---- Mitochondrial filtering on both sets ----
training <- subset(training, subset = percent.mt <= mito_max)
projection <- subset(projection, subset = percent.mt <= mito_max)

message(sprintf("Training cells: %d | Projection cells: %d",
                ncol(training), ncol(projection)))

# ---- Normalize + HVGs on training only (to match paper’s flow) ----
training <- NormalizeData(training, normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
training <- FindVariableFeatures(training, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = n_hvgs)
training <- ScaleData(training, features = VariableFeatures(training), vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
training <- RunPCA(training, features = VariableFeatures(training), npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)

# ---- Graph clustering with SLM (smart local moving) ----
training <- FindNeighbors(training, dims = 1:n_pcs)
training <- FindClusters(training, resolution = cluster_res, algorithm = 3, random.seed = seed) # algorithm=3 = SLM
training <- RunTSNE(training, dims = 1:n_pcs, perplexity = tsne_perp)

# cluster labels live in training$seurat_clusters
DimPlot(training, reduction = "tsne", label = TRUE) + ggtitle("Training set clusters (t-SNE)")

# ---- Prepare projection set on the same features/space ----
# Normalize/scale using the same HVG set to align with training feature space
hvg <- VariableFeatures(training)
projection <- NormalizeData(projection)
projection <- ScaleData(projection, features = hvg, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")
projection <- RunPCA(projection, features = hvg, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)

# ---- Random forest: train on training PCA, predict for projection ----
x_train <- Embeddings(training, "pca")[, 1:n_pcs, drop = FALSE]
y_train <- factor(training$seurat_clusters)

rf <- randomForest(x = x_train, y = y_train, ntree = rf_trees, importance = FALSE)
proj_pred <- predict(rf, newdata = Embeddings(projection, "pca")[, 1:n_pcs, drop = FALSE], type = "vote")
proj_call <- colnames(proj_pred)[max.col(proj_pred, ties.method = "first")]

projection$rf_cluster <- factor(proj_call, levels = levels(y_train))
projection$rf_maxvote <- apply(proj_pred, 1, max)

# ---- Optional: joint visualization (run t-SNE on combined PCA for a single map) ----
# Recreate a combined object using the same HVGs and PCs for both sets
xy_combined <- merge(training, projection)
xy_combined <- ScaleData(xy_combined, features = hvg, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE)
xy_combined <- RunPCA(xy_combined, features = hvg, npcs = n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
xy_combined <- RunTSNE(xy_combined, dims = 1:n_pcs, perplexity = tsne_perp)

# Carry cluster labels (training) and RF labels (projection) onto combined object
xy_combined$label_for_plot <- NA
xy_combined$label_for_plot[colnames(training)] <- paste0("Train_", training$seurat_clusters)
xy_combined$label_for_plot[colnames(projection)] <- paste0("Proj_", projection$rf_cluster)

DimPlot(xy_combined, reduction = "tsne", group.by = "label_for_plot", label = FALSE, shuffle = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Training clusters + projected cells (RF)")

# ---- 6-fold subset validation (like Extended Data Fig. 1b) ----
# Reference = full training RF predictions on projection set (proj_call)
ref_proj_call <- projection$rf_cluster

K <- 6
folds <- sample(rep(1:K, length.out = length(y_train)))

match_rate_by_fold <- numeric(K)
match_rate_by_cluster <- vector("list", K)

for (k in 1:K) {
  idx <- which(folds == k)
  x_sub <- x_train[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  y_sub <- y_train[idx]
  rf_k <- randomForest(x = x_sub, y = y_sub, ntree = rf_trees)
  pred_k <- predict(rf_k, newdata = Embeddings(projection, "pca")[, 1:n_pcs, drop = FALSE])
  # Compare projection labels from subset-vs-full classifiers
  matches <- pred_k == ref_proj_call
  match_rate_by_fold[k] <- mean(matches)
  # per-cluster agreement (by full-set label)
  per_cl <- tapply(matches, ref_proj_call, mean) #means here [0-1] show if cluster "ref numer" agrees with cluster "fold predicted number"
  match_rate_by_cluster[[k]] <- per_cl
}

# Summaries
overall_consistency <- data.frame(
  fold = 1:K,
  match_rate = match_rate_by_fold
)

print(overall_consistency)

# Aggregate per-cluster consistency across folds
all_clusters <- sort(unique(ref_proj_call))
per_cluster_mat <- sapply(1:K, function(k) {
  x <- match_rate_by_cluster[[k]]
  setNames(x[all_clusters], all_clusters)
})
per_cluster_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = all_clusters,
  consistency = rowMeans(per_cluster_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
)

ggplot(overall_consistency, aes(factor(fold), match_rate)) +
  geom_col() + labs(x = "Subset fold", y = "Agreement with full-set projection",
                    title = "Projection label consistency across 6 training subsets") +
  ylim(0, 1)

ggplot(per_cluster_df, aes(cluster, consistency)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Projected cluster (full-set RF call)",
       y = "Mean agreement across folds",
       title = "Per-cluster projection consistency") +
  ylim(0, 1)

xy_combined$final_cluster <- ifelse(
  is.na(xy_combined$seurat_clusters),
  as.character(xy_combined$rf_cluster),
  as.character(xy_combined$seurat_clusters)
)

# make it a factor with consistent levels
xy_combined$final_cluster <- factor(xy_combined$final_cluster)
obj = JoinLayers(xy_combined)


```

```{r}

# Find markers for your clusters
markers <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# markers has: cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, p_val_adj, etc.

# Load their marker table (saved from Supplementary)
paper_markers <- readxl::read_xlsx("~/Downloads/41593_2020_586_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx", skip = 3, sheet = 1) %>% select(1:7)
# For each cluster, see which paper-defined markers are enriched
clusters <- levels(obj$final_cluster)
best_paper_clusters = c()
for (cl in clusters) {
  my_markers <- markers %>% filter(cluster == cl) %>% pull(gene)
  overlap <- paper_markers %>% filter(`gene...7` %in% my_markers)
  best_paper_clusters = c(best_paper_clusters, names(sort(table(overlap$cluster...6), decreasing = T)[1]))
}
best_match <- data.frame(seurat_cluster = clusters, best_paper_clusters = best_paper_clusters)



# Add cell type labels to metadata
xy_combined$seurat_clusters <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x = as.character(xy_combined$final_cluster),
  from = best_match$seurat_cluster,
  to = best_match$best_paper_clusters
)

# Add cell type labels to metadata
training$celltype <- plyr::mapvalues(
  x = as.character(training$seurat_clusters),
  from = best_match$seurat_cluster,
  to = best_match$best_paper_clusters
)

#  make factor with nice ordering
xy_combined$seurat_clusters <- factor(xy_combined$seurat_clusters)
training$celltype <- factor(training$celltype)


# ---- Save useful outputs ----
# training (clustered), projection with RF labels, combined t-SNE

saveRDS(xy_combined,  file = "~/Desktop/SCN_mouse_custom_clustering.rds")
```

Do Orpheus:

```{r}
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in unique(xy_combined$celltype)){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))

seurat_obj = JoinLayers(xy_combined)
# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input2(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T, num_replicates = 2)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# ZT = as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat))

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(acrophase_bulk) %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.1

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)


phi = calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)

plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Actb"))

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) = paste0(cell_type,"_seed" ,seed)
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}

```
